Source.Drop: Drop files here or click to choose
Source.Formats: JSON (Foundry exports or simplified), plain text (.txt, .md), PDF — several at once
Source.DefaultTypeHint: Used when an entry has no recognisable type, labels or section heading.
Source.ForceTypeHint: Leave on Detect unless the whole source is one kind of thing (e.g. a list of spells).

Pdf.Hint: Extracted text is added to the text box above for review. Columns are read one after another, and page numbers, running headers and side navigation tabs are left out. Scanned (image-only) PDFs have no text to extract.
Pdf.Done: PDF text extracted. Review it, then Parse.
Pdf.EmptyPages: {name}: no text found on page(s) {pages}. These may be scanned images.
Pdf.Decoded: {name}: this PDF's fonts have no character table, so its text was decoded by the importer. Check the text before parsing; characters it could not work out are shown as �.

Help.Summary: Formatting guide: what the importer expects
Help.Intro: Pick a kind of entry to see how it should be laid out. Insert example adds a sample to the text box so you can try it or copy its layout. Several entries can go in one paste; separate unrelated ones with a blank line or ---.

Preview.Heading: {count} entries found
Preview.Hint: Untick entries to skip them. Change the type to re-read an entry. Expand an entry to edit its data.
Preview.Plan: Skills and owned items added after creation

Import.Duplicates: If a document with the same name and type exists
Import.MatchItems: Copy owned items from world Items and compendiums when the names match
Import.MatchItemsHint: Weapons, spells, powers, qualities and ware on stat blocks are copied with full data when found; otherwise they are built from the stat block.
Import.ReconcileHint: Adds an effect for augmented attributes like 4(5), and adjusts initiative, armor, condition monitors and limits to the numbers in the stat block.
Import.Failed: {count} entries failed to import. See the summary.
Import.MatchedLine: Owned items: {matched} copied from your library, {built} built from the stat block.

Notes.Skipped: {count} table line(s) could not be read: {lines}

Warnings.CustomSkill: Skill "{name}" was not found in the skills compendium and was created as a custom skill.
Warnings.LegacySkillMissing: Skill "{name}" has no matching active skill on this system version and was skipped.
Warnings.ArmorAdjusted: Armor modifier {diff} applied to match the printed armor value.
Warnings.NameOnly: No match in your Items or compendiums, created with the name only: {names}. Fill them in on the sheet, or import a compendium of them first and re-import.

Errors.WrongSystem: SR5 Importer needs the Shadowrun 5th Edition system.
Errors.NothingFound: Nothing to import was found. Open the Formatting guide under Parsing to see the layout each kind of entry needs, or choose a type under Parsing.
Errors.UnknownType: "{type}" is not a {document} type in this system version.
Errors.ChildTypeUnknown: {name}: item type "{type}" does not exist in this system version; skipped.
Errors.UnsupportedFile: {name} is not a JSON, text or PDF file.
Errors.CreateFailed: Foundry did not create the document.
